summary.intent: Complete GSD phase 70 (rotation soundness: deep-merge, fresh-record-resume, durable floor concurrency) for the cipher-box project by verifying gate tests, running phase-completion verification, and reconciling bookkeeping before marking the phase done.
summary.outcome: Phase 70 marked complete (8/8 plans) after independently re-confirming all 4 gate tests (including the concurrent-add test that caught a real bug) and a 6/6 goal-backward verification pass; VALIDATION.md frontmatter was corrected from stale draft/pending to reflect passing SC commands, and completion bookkeeping was committed, with 5 source todos deliberately left unretired for later triage.

repo: Phase 70's directory name is long enough to be truncated on the filesystem: the full descriptive name ends in '...durable-floor-concurrency' but the actual directory is '...durabl' — must fetch the exact truncated path before editing files inside it.

VALIDATION.md frontmatter can go stale (remain 'draft'/all-pending) even after its SC commands actually pass — must be manually corrected before completing the phase, or it misleads later ship review.
workflow: For load-bearing gates, independently re-run the tests yourself rather than trusting a subagent/executor's report that they passed.

Verifier subagents may lack permissions to access secret files needed for certain tests (e.g. live sdk-e2e) — the main session must independently confirm those specific gates itself rather than relying on the verifier's partial coverage.

When a phase has source todos with stale `resolves_phase` pointers or bundled 'followups/hardening' todos, don't auto-retire them all during phase complete — triage 1:1 mappings to verified success criteria and flag ambiguous bundles separately to avoid over-closing unfinished work.

friction: Verifier agent could not run the live sdk-e2e gate test because its permissions excluded the required secret file, requiring a separate independent confirmation step.
Phase directory path was long enough to be truncated, requiring an extra lookup step before editing VALIDATION.md.
VALIDATION.md frontmatter was out of sync with actual (passing) SC command results, requiring manual correction before phase completion.
open_items: 5 phase-70 source todos remain in pending/ and were not retired: 3 map 1:1 to verified SCs but carry a stale resolves_phase: 68, and 2 are 'followups/hardening' bundles that may hold residual unverified items — flagged for manual triage rather than closed.
